notes: Payer mix, reimbursement and volume are from general knowledge, not the evidence; no quality metric or capacity figure is given.

healthcare_provider_setting.value: Outpatient physical and occupational therapy clinics, plus management of therapy facilities for hospitals and physician groups and onsite industrial injury prevention

clinical_specialty.value: Physical and occupational therapy: orthopedic and sports injuries, post-operative care, neurological injuries, worker rehabilitation

patient_activity_volume.value: Very large volume of outpatient therapy visits per year across its national clinic network

payer_revenue_mix.value: Mix of commercial insurance, Medicare, workers' compensation and other payers, with commercial the largest

payment_reimbursement_model.value: Fee-for-service per-visit reimbursement for clinics; management fees for managed hospital and physician-group facilities; contract fees for industrial injury prevention

setting_specific_capacity.value: Large national network of outpatient therapy clinics, mostly through partnerships with retained clinic-owner stakes

patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Routine outpatient therapy: pre- and post-operative orthopedic, sports injury, neurological and injured-worker rehabilitation
